Q5926038.description: property to indicate that an item is of particular interest for a Wikimedia project. This property does not add notability. Items should not be created with this property if they are not notable for Wikidata. See also P6104, P972, P2354.

Q5926038.label: date of birth
Q5926038.description: date on which the subject was born

Q5926038.label: copyright representative
Q5926038.description: person or organisation who represents the copyright for this person or work of art

Q5926038.label: has works in the collection
Q5926038.description: collection that has works of this person or organisation (use archives at [P485] for archives)

Q5926038.label: given name
Q5926038.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names

Q5926038.label: copyright status as a creator
Q5926038.description: states if the body of work published during the lifetime of this creator is still copyrighted or in the public domain

Q5926038.label: official website
Q5926038.description: URL of the official page of an item (current or former). Usage: If a listed URL no longer points to the official website, do not remove it, but see the "Hijacked or dead websites" section of the Talk page

Q5926038.label: work location
Q5926038.description: location where persons or organisations were actively participating in employment, business or other work

Q592701.label: occupation
Q592701.description: occupation of a person; see also "field of work" (Property:P101), "position held" (Property:P39)

Q592701.label: religion or worldview
Q592701.description: religion of a person, organization or religious building, or associated with this subject

Q592701.label: place of birth
Q592701.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q592701.label: place of death
Q592701.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) death location of a person, animal or fictional character

Q592701.label: sex or gender
Q592701.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

Q592701.label: country of citizenship
Q592701.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

Q592701.label: instance of
Q592701.description: that class of which this subject is a particular example and member; different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain (and an instance of volcanic landform)

Q592701.label: position held
Q592701.description: subject currently or formerly holds the object position or public office

Q592701.label: coat of arms image
Q592701.description: image of the item's coat of arms - for the shield part only use P4004

Q592701.label: consecrator
Q592701.description: bishop who presided as consecrator or co-consecrator of this bishop

Q592701.label: date of birth
Q592701.description: date on which the subject was born

Q592701.label: date of death
Q592701.description: date on which the subject died

Q592701.label: family name
Q592701.description: part of full name of person

Q592701.label: given name
Q592701.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names
